question.problem: Find the average value of the function $f(x,y)={x}^{2}-4{y}^{3}$ on the region $D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 3\}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that 

$$
\text{Area}(D)=1\cdot 3=3.
$$

Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{ave}} & =\frac{1}{\text{Area}(D)}\,{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{∬}_{D}({x}^{2}-4{y}^{3})\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{3}({x}^{2}-4{y}^{3})\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}[{x}^{2}y-{y}^{4}]_{y=0}^{y=3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}(3{x}^{2}-81)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[{x}^{3}-81x]_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}({1}^{3}-81\cdot 1) \\  & =-\frac{80}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
